1 (Currently amended): A loading ramp, said loading ramp comprising: a support structure having a mounting member, said mounting member being compatible with a truck having a bed such that said support structure is adapted to be removably mounted to the truck; a first gradient member secured to said support structure, said first gradient member defining a first surface, a proximate end, and a distal end, the proximate end being opposite the distal end with respect to the first surface, the proximate end being proximate the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck, the first surface being structured to support a small vehicle; and a second gradient member secured to said first gradient member at the distal end such that said second gradient member pivots at the distal end to the extent that said second gradient member is capable of an up position and a down position, said second gradient member defining a second surface, the second surface being structured to support the small vehicle, said first gradient member and said second gradient member defining a gradient between a ground surface and the bed of the truck when said second gradient member is at the down position and said support structure is mounted to the truck, the gradient being traversable by the small vehicle, said loading ramp being carried by the truck when said second gradient member is at the up position and said support structure is mounted to the truck, said loading ramp not limiting the storage space provided by the truck when said loading ramp is carried by the truck while maintaining a functional compatibility with the stored small vehicle.

2 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said loading ramp, when carried by the truck, maintains storage space for the truck otherwise occupied when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are positioned on the truck.

3 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 2 wherein said loading ramp supports at least a portion of the small vehicle when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are positioned on the truck.

4 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said mounting member is compatible with a receiver-type hitch for secure attachment to the truck.

5 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said support structure is adjustable such that the proximate end of said first gradient member is adaptively secured adjacent to the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to various sizes of trucks.

6 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the proximate end of said first gradient member is structured to rest against a rear bumper of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck.

7 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the proximate end of said first gradient member is structured to rest against the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck, supporting a load.

9 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the first surface defined by said first gradient member includes a rigid surface configured to distribute load evenly.

12 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the second surface defined by said second gradient member includes a rigid surface configured to provide stability for the small vehicle when in use.

19 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a mechanical device, said mechanical device facilitating movement of said second gradient member between the up position and down position.

20 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a locking member, said locking member securing said second gradient member at the up position to prevent accidental movements.

23 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a locking member that includes a mechanical means for securing said second gradient member in the up position.

30 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the truck is specifically any vehicle designated with a truck bed, including pickup trucks and sports utility vehicles designed for trailers.
